verdict.rationale: Loading model formats is a fair question for a local LLM runner, so the axis applies. However, no item in the evidence pack names the GGUF format. The pack mentions a `llama.cpp` engine and MLX models, but tying that engine to GGUF would need outside knowledge, so it is not credited here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and run models packaged in the GGUF format
